as_root.description: Allow the daemon to be started as root.

persistence_file.description: Specifies the location of the persistence file. Defaults to ~/.local/share/openrazer/persistence.

run_dir.description: The directory the daemon changes to once started. Defaults to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR or ~/.local/share/openrazer/.

log_dir.description: The directory for log files. Defaults to ~/.local/share/openrazer/logs/.

test_dir.description: Directory for test-driver mode exposing fake devices. Empty string disables test mode.

config_file.description: The location of this configuration file.
